rec.capacityComment: capacity = real head-count capacity of the building. widgetMax = MAX_CAPACITY hard-coded in the public Rec widget (gist copy on the university site). /recapi scales data.patrons by widgetMax/capacity so the widget shows the right percentage without editing it.

collection.comment: Silent window [start, end) in Eastern hours: DB writes are skipped while start <= hour < end. The Rec opens earlier than King, so it resumes collecting at 05:00.
